faqs.q: Why is my MyServiceNSW Account for me only?
faqs.a: For security and privacy reasons, your MyServiceNSW Account is for you only.

faqs.q: What should I do if I have more than one MyServiceNSW Account or a shared account?
faqs.a: You need to take steps to manage the accounts, including keeping your account details private, not using a shared email, stopping sharing, deactivating unused accounts, and removing personal details and services from other accounts.
